name: CairnJS API Reference
description: Complete machine-readable and verified API reference for CairnJS zero-dependency reactive UI framework.

returns.description: Object with .value getter/setter and subscriber tracking

params.name: target
params.description: CSS selector or DOM container element

tags.description: Procedural tag helpers: div, span, button, input, h1-h6, p, ul, li, form, table, etc.

html.description: Pure HTML tagged template literal supporting :bind, :style, @click

spring.signature: spring({ from, to, stiffness, damping, velocity, onUpdate, onComplete })
spring.description: 60 FPS hardware-accelerated analytical damped harmonic oscillator physics

transition.description: Fluid DOM morph and element transition orchestrator

cairnError.description: Outputs standard Three-Part Cairn Diagnostic (Summary, Location, Actionable Fix)

customize.description: Registers or overrides custom domain-specific error templates

setFormatter.description: Connects global error handling directly into custom console formatters or APM telemetry

toReact.description: Wraps Cairn component into a native React component

toVue.description: Wraps Cairn component into a native Vue 3 component definition

toSvelte.description: Wraps Cairn component into a Svelte action handler

toAngular.description: Wraps Cairn component into an Angular directive
